create_COCOEvaluator: create a COCOEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segm, or keypoint detection on a named dataset
run_COCOEvaluator_evaluate: run COCOEvaluator.evaluate to compute AP and AR metrics on collected predictions and return results
test_instances_to_coco_json: test instances_to_coco_json to convert a detectron2 Instances object into COCO-format JSON for evaluation
review_COCOevalMaxDets_summarize: review COCOevalMaxDets.summarize to compute summary metrics with a custom maxDets value instead of the default 100
refactor__evaluate_box_proposals: refactor _evaluate_box_proposals to customize detection proposal recall evaluation with different area ranges or limits
